plan.text: Aaj samjhao-revision — Context Window. 9 axis, har axis pe pehle tumhara ek-line jawab, phir tumhara locked weld verbatim, phir ek check-question. Chalein?
Axis a — Kya hai + analogy. Gut-word, phir ek line mein: Context window exactly kya hai? Yeh model ki 'memory' hai? Do alag messages ke beech model purani baat kaise yaad rakhta?

Context window = woh max BUNDLE (tokens mein) jo model HAR call pe ek saath padh sakta. Memory NAHI - RE-FEEDING. Model stateless: do calls ke beech ZERO memory. Analogy: AMNESIAC GENIUS - har 5 sec memory wipe; baat aage badhane ka ek hi tarika = use poora folder (ab tak ki saari baat) HAR baar dobara padhao. Folder = context = system rules + saare pichhle turns (tere + AI ke dono) + naya sawaal. Folder ki motai = tokens. [Stuck: pehle laga 'model ko yaad rehta hai' -> Jirah ne khola yaad nahi rehta, har baar re-feed hota.]

Axis b — Kyun bounded (3 dushman) + first-principles. Gut-word, phir ek line mein: Window infinite kyun nahi? Bas RAM/GPU badha do na - phir? Need ko scratch se reinvent kar: kya rok raha hai use unbounded hone se?

3 DUSHMAN, do family. MACHINE-LIMITS (hardware se solvable): #1 KV-CACHE MEMORY (bada folder -> zyada GPU VRAM), #2 PER-STEP COMPUTE (har naya token poore folder ke KV pe re-attend). QUALITY-LIMIT (hardware se NAHI theek hota): #3 LOST-IN-THE-MIDDLE - U-shaped: start+end strong, BEECH ka maal model miss karta CHAHE wahin maujood ho (gayab nahi, ignored); kyun = attention lambe context mein patli phailti, beech ka signal doob jaata (2023 paper). SENIOR SIGNAL: infinite RAM+compute aa bhi jaye -> #1,#2 solve, par #3 PHIR BHI rehta. Bada window != behtar jawab. [attention ka faster-than-linear ka asli math = NN-internals (#4), park.]
Axis c — Mechanism - NAME it (FIFO sliding window). Gut-word, phir ek line mein: Window full ho gaya - ab kya hota? Mechanism ko NAME kar. Kya model khud decide karta kaunsi baat girni hai?

SLIDING WINDOW = FIFO on the context folder. Folder full -> sabse PURANI cheez bahar (chahe user sawaal ho ya AI jawab - speaker matter NAHI, sirf 'oldest' matter) -> nayi cheez andar. Box hamesha latest pe khiska. MYTH TOD: model DECIDE nahi karta kya girega - yeh mechanical CHOP hai, CODE mein, model ke chalne se PEHLE (`if tokens>limit: drop oldest`). SILENT DATA LOSS: no error/warning - turn-20 pe model turn-2 wali baat 'bhool' jaata (truncate ho chuki). FinOps demo-killer. [Stuck: pehle laga 'user prompt protected, AI reply girti' -> ULTA: FIFO oldest-first, speaker irrelevant; tera apna purana sawaal bhi nikal sakta.]
Axis d — Math + range + COST (kaun bharta). Gut-word, phir ek line mein: Window ka size numbers mein? 4k/128k/200k/1M ka insaani matlab? Aur compute kahan chalta, paisa kaun deta - user ya company?

1 token ~ 3/4 word (~4 chars Eng). 4k~3k words(~6pg) | 128k~75k(ek novel, sweet spot) | 200k~2 novels | 1M~750k(~10 novels). Real ranges (interview): ~4k(GPT-3.5 era) | ~128k(GPT-4 class, common) | ~200k(Claude) | ~1M+(Gemini frontier). FinOps: invoice~500-1000 tok -> 128k ~150 invoices/call; chat turn~100-500 tok. KEY DISTINCTION: 300k doc vs 128k window = #1 'FIT NAHI HUA' (capacity; ~172k ghuste hi nahi, model DEKHTA hi nahi) != #2 lost-in-middle (quality; content andar par beech under-weighted, sirf ANDAR ke maal pe). 'Pehle fit, PHIR beech.' COST: compute COMPANY ki GPU pe (VRAM/bijli unka) PAR paisa USER deta PER-TOKEN (API = per-token billing, GPU-seconds NAHI; GPU efficiency = compa…
Axis e — Limits - truncation (silent loss). Gut-word, phir ek line mein: Truncation exactly kaise hota? Model padhta hai phir jitne tokens/logits fit karta utne store karta - aisa hota hai?

TRUNCATION = `if tokens > limit: drop oldest` - CODE mein, TOKENS pe, model CHALNE se PEHLE. Cut tokens model tak pahunchte hi NAHI -> un pe logits bante hi NAHI. LOGITS ka truncation mein ROLE NAHI. SILENT LOSS: no error/warning, turn-20 pe turn-2 'bhool'. FinOps demo-killer. [Stuck: pehle laga 'model top-to-bottom read -> har token ke logits -> jitne fit store -> baaki cut' -> GALAT: chop CODE mein hota model se pehle; logits ka role nahi.] ('kab NAHI' + truncate-vs-summarize-vs-RAG tradeoff -> axis-f.)
Axis f — Tradeoffs - truncate vs summarize vs RAG. Gut-word, phir ek line mein: Folder bhar gaya - sirf chop hi raasta hai? Aur kya options hain, aur kab kaunsa use karega?

3 RAASTE jab folder bhare: (1) TRUNCATE/CHOP - FIFO oldest drop, KV free. +simple/sasta/instant -chopped baat HAMESHA gayi, silent loss, 'dumbest' (kya chop kar raha dekhta tak nahi). (2) SUMMARIZE/NICHOD - purane tokens -> chhota summary, context mein rakho. +matlab zinda+jagah bachi -ek EXTRA AI call (paisa+latency), detail kho sakti, lossy par chop se kam. (3) RAG - purana data vector DB mein BAHAR, per-query sirf relevant chunk retrieve. +context chhota+focused, kuch permanently nahi khota, lost-in-middle ka bhi ilaaj -sabse zyada machinery (embeddings+vector search+chunking, Sprint 5), galat retrieval=galat context. KAB: chop->purani baat sach mein bekaar (casual). summarize->gist chah…
Axis g — FinOps spot + defend-able decision. Gut-word, phir ek line mein: FinOps chat-copilot mein context kaise manage karega? Ek decision do jo tu interview mein KHUD defend kare.

chat-copilot context = LAYERED (ek hathoda sab pe NAHI): (1) Recent ~5-10 turns -> VERBATIM (koi tool nahi; sabse relevant, exact). (2) Beech ki purani chat -> SUMMARIZE (gist kaam ka, jagah bachi). (3) Bada vendor-data (saare invoices, past allocations) -> RAG (chat ka hissa hi nahi - files/DB, bahut bada, context mein poora aata hi nahi; 'Noida last time?' -> vector search se woh record retrieve). DEFEND LINE: 'recent verbatim + beech summarize + vendor-data RAG - kyun? Har turn poora folder re-attend karta (cost+latency), aur sab thoonsne se lost-in-middle quality girti. Recent exact, old compress, bada data fetch-on-demand -> cost+capacity+quality teeno balance.' BONUS: layering sirf ja…
Axis h — Scale/cost/gotcha + KV cache CONCRETE. Gut-word, phir ek line mein: KV cache dikhta kaisa hai? 100k+ tokens pe kya tootta? Har layer pe same KV? Reply ke baad uski KV remove hoti?

KV CACHE = box-of-cards: har TOKEN = ek CARD (uske Key+Value vectors). Ek box nahi - har LAYER ka apna box (e.g. 32 stacked); har layer us token ka apna ALAG K/V banati (same token, 32 ALAG cards). Naya word -> 1 naya card (COMPUTE=1 constant) PAR saare cards padhta (READS=N badhta, re-attention). SIZE: ~0.5 MB/token (32 layers, fp16, hidden~4096, illustrative) -> LINEAR (tokens x 0.5MB) -> 128k = ~64 GB VRAM, weights ke ALAG+UPAR. = dushman #1, window hardware-bounded. INTERVIEW: linear+64GB+memory-bound INTUITION chahiye; derivation RECITE nahi karni. REPLY KV STAYS: ek chat ke ANDAR cards sirf ADD (sawaal+reply dono), hatte tab jab window FULL (FIFO) ya chat khatam. Naya API call = fresh…

Axis i — Samjhao 3 ways - CEO / junior / skeptic. Gut-word, phir ek line mein: Context window CEO ko, junior dev ko, aur skeptical senior ko - teen alag register mein samjha. (Register-switching = 'Product' muscle.)

CEO = business (model kitni data ek baari dimag mein rakhe; choti window=truncate, badi=paisa+time; utni do ki quality bhi na gire aur cost bhi na badhe). JUNIOR = mechanics (stateless, folder har prompt re-fed, folder ki KV GPU pe, next word se pehle KV READ = re-attention NOT re-computation; window full -> CODE FIFO truncate, model+GPU ko bhejne se PEHLE; sirf chopped tokens permanently gaye). SKEPTIC = tradeoffs (3 options se pehle - bada window FREE NAHI: KV linear 128k~64GB VRAM memory-bound + lost-in-the-middle quality girti; isliye andha bada-window nahi - recent verbatim + old summarize + bada data RAG, cost/capacity/quality balance). [exact words threeWays mein - SACRED.]
Revision poori — 'full time' bolo to band karta hoon.
